endDate.description: Consumed to skip plans that have already ended (date-only, e.g. "2026-10-18T00:00:00.0").

taskList.description: Always null here in this account's captured sample — populated only via get_adaptive_training_plan_by_id.

adaptivePlanPhases.description: Always null here — see taskList note.

planPhases.description: Always null here — see taskList note.

searchFilter.description: Not consumed. Echoes the (implicit, account-scoped) query — ownerId, pagination (start/limit), and empty/null filter criteria.

title: Training plan list (get_training_plans)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_training_plans() — no arguments, implicitly scoped to the logged-in account. Consumed by sync_training_plan as the entry point to discover active trainingPlanId(s).
